from.place: proof, step (4) 'Connectedness': the assertion that a product of geometrically irreducible schemes is irreducible

title: Components of a product with a geometrically irreducible scheme
statement: Let $K$ be a field, let $U$ be a geometrically irreducible scheme over $K$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], and let $V$ be any scheme over $K$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base]. Then the projection $U\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}V\to V$ induces a bijection between the irreducible components of $U\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}V$ and the irreducible components of $V$ [def-weil-irreducible-components].
